pages.title: Dilaton Ore
pages.text: Pale, oddly variable mineral whose hardness seems to drift as I handle it. The dilaton is the scalar field in string theory that sets the coupling strength of strings; here it is pinned into crystal, and wherever it sits the rules of interaction loosen or tighten slightly.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the bulk stone a seam kept changing how hard my tools struck it. Plotting the variance against depth, I realised the local string coupling was shifting, a frozen dilaton field showing through the rock.
$(thing)Found$(): in veins through the Bulk (mine it for its drop).
